groundTruth.description: The Favorites view must not recommend opening the Favorites view itself.

hypotheses.title: The 'Abrir favoritos' button is not visible when the user has no saved items.
hypotheses.expectedBehavior: 'Abrir favoritos' should be visible regardless of the number of saved items.
hypotheses.oracle: Verify that the button is still present when clicking on it with no saved items.

hypotheses.title: The 'Seu coração ainda está leve' message is misleading, as users can save items without a heart icon.
hypotheses.expectedBehavior: 'Seu coração ainda está leve' should only be displayed when the user has saved at least one item with a heart icon.
hypotheses.oracle: Check if the message is updated to reflect the correct state of the user's saved items.

hypotheses.title: The 'Abrir meus favoritos' link is not clearly distinguishable from other links.
hypotheses.expectedBehavior: 'Abrir meus favoritos' should be visually distinct from other links, such as the 'Fotografias reais via Unsplash' link.
hypotheses.oracle: Verify that the link is styled differently than other links on the page.

reviews.title: The 'Abrir favoritos' button is not visible when the user has no saved items.
reviews.reason: Expected behavior does not match observed evidence. The 'Abrir favoritos' button is present in the list of buttons, regardless of the number of saved items.

reviews.title: The 'Seu coração ainda está leve' message is misleading, as users can save items without a heart icon.
reviews.reason: Expected behavior does not match observed evidence. The 'Seu coração ainda está leve' message is present in the list of headings, regardless of whether the user has saved at least one item with a heart icon.

reviews.title: The 'Abrir meus favoritos' link is not clearly distinguishable from other links.
reviews.reason: Expected behavior does not match observed evidence. The 'Abrir meus favoritos' link is not visually distinct from the 'Fotografias reais via Unsplash' link, as both are presented in a similar format.
